perspective: Simulated low-vision and limited-hand-movement evaluation; not patient testimony or accessibility certification.
verdict: Useful, well-labelled draft prototype with an observed narrow-screen large-text reading barrier and an avoidable immediate appointment-sheet deletion risk. Not clinically or accessibly certified.
strengths: All nine menu destinations and keyboard navigation paths were exercised.
All seven guides were inspected end-to-end through source/review records.
The saved hub uses generic labels and actual synthetic exports were inspected.
Card edit/reload and explicit deletion cancel/confirm flows worked.
frustrations: Home heading splits a word mid-word at 200% app text on 390 px and 320 px widths.
Appointment sheet deletion removed saved data immediately without a cancel/undo step.
Card print-preview cancellation was not verifiable; Escape did not dismiss it.
Actual browser zoom, screen-reader behavior, and audible read-aloud output were not available.
firstImprovement: Preserve whole-word wrapping in the Home heading at 200% app text on narrow screens, then add a cancelable confirmation for appointment-sheet deletion.
